newsitem.title: FRANCE: French health spending unchanged in August.
newsitem.headline: French health spending unchanged in August.

text.p: French healthcare spending in August was unchanged from July at 32.88 billion francs, national health insurance fund Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Maladie (CNAM) said on Tuesday.
Spending was up 1.6 percent from August 1995 and up 0.5 percent in the first eight months of 1996 compared with December 1995, it said in a statement.
